summary: Frontend testing for LOTR 5e Travel System bug fixes. Fixed critical bug where map was not showing on results screen. All 3 requested features now verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: JourneyMiniMap was receiving incorrect coordinates path - was using journeyCalc?.origen_coords but API returns them at journeyCalc?.ruta?.origen_coords
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix applied to EnhancedTravelSystem.jsx line 3490-3491 - changed journeyCalc?.origen_coords to journeyCalc?.ruta?.origen_coords. All travel system features now working correctly including the results screen map and print functionality.

F1_journey_completion_flow.description: Journey completion transitions correctly to results screen after all events resolved
F1_journey_completion_flow.evidence: Completed journey Hobbiton→Bree, after 8-10 steps reached 'Viaje Completado' results screen

F2_results_screen_map_with_markers.description: Results screen shows JourneyMiniMap with route, origin/destination markers, and event markers
F2_results_screen_map_with_markers.evidence: Map displays Middle Earth background, brown route line, green origin marker at Hobbiton, red X destination marker at Bree, legend with Origen/Destino/Éxito/Fracaso
F2_results_screen_map_with_markers.bug_fixed: Changed journeyCalc?.origen_coords to journeyCalc?.ruta?.origen_coords (same for destino_coords)

F3_print_chronicle_with_map.description: Imprimir Crónica button uses html2canvas to capture map and opens print window
F3_print_chronicle_with_map.evidence: Clicked 'Imprimir Crónica' button, popup window opened successfully, popup contains img tag with captured map

bug_fix_details.root_cause: The API returns coordinates nested inside the 'ruta' object, but the frontend was looking for them at the top level of the response
